en: (Maybe I should call Hinata.)
Sorry for the wait! And good idea thinking of calling me! I've been rocking karaoke all day! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
(Maybe I should call Hinata-chan.)
(I'll call Akiyama-san.)
Sorry to make you wait, Haruka-chan!
(I guess I should get them talking. What should I talk about?)
So, um, how's school?
What do you mean, how's school?
Uh, well, I haven't been able to attend very much lately.
Well, nothin's really happenin'. It's gonna be winter break soon.
Huh? Nothin's happenin'? That's not true, Madoka. Yamamoto asked you out, didn't he?
Well that's not even important! I got a boyfriend already, anyway.
(Okay, this girl's named Madoka. I better not forget.)
You say that, Hiromi, but you're turnin' things up with Shino-senpai. You're textin' him all day long.
Pfft. I don't even text him that much.
(This girl's Hiromi. I'm sure glad I didn't have to ask my classmates what their names are.)
Um, you two are pretty close, huh?
Well, yeah, we grew up together.
Oh, that must be nice. I moved here from Okinawa, so most of my childhood friends are still over there...
I dunno, I'm super jealous you got to live in Okinawa. It's so nice over there.
Just get your boyfriend to take you to Okinawa, Madoka.
Uh, how rich do you think he is? That ain't happenin'.
Heh, you could always ask Shino-senpai, Hiromi. Just tell him you wanna go to Okinawa. See if he'll put up.
Please, like that's gonna happen.
Uh, um, I'm sorry, what were your names again?
Huh? Haruka-chan, ya don't remember our names?
No way! Seriously!?
I'm so sorry! I haven't made friends in class, and I haven't been able to attend school very much...
Sure, I guess, but still...
Huh. Well, I'm Madoka.
And I'm Hiromi. Don't forget again, okay?
I'm really sorry!
(I should have been more subtle about getting their names. Now they're mad at me...)
So, ya know how skin dries out in the winter? That's why you gotta take care of your lips. Keep 'em plushy and kissable.
It's no biggie during school, but you don't wanna be on a hot date and puckerin' up with bone-dry lips. You want 'em cute and tempting, yeah?
Oh, no doubt, no doubt. You agree, don'tcha, Haruka-chan?
Oh, uh, yeah. My lips get chapped all the time.
Yeah, but ya know how there's all kinds of lipstick? You gotta choose wisely. You know Kani-chan? She uses Bentendo's Marouge.
You saw that on TV, didn't ya? Is that why you're all about Marouge lately?
Hiromi, you use Appleton, right?
Yeah, Appleton's the bomb. It's super glossy, so it makes my lips all shiny and perfect.
(They're throwing around all these brand names I've never heard of. I wish I knew what they were talking about...)
Hey, Haruka-chan, what do you use on your lips?
Huh? You mean like uh, lipstick? Uhh...
(I have to keep up with them. What should I say I use?)
Kani-chan, I think?
Wait, what? Kani-chan? She doesn't have her own line yet.
Do ya even know who Kani-chan is? She's a pretty famous model. But forget that, I wanna know what kind of lipstick you're usin'.
Oh. That's right.
Are ya really listenin' to us, Haruka-chan?
Ya seem kinda distracted.
(I screwed up. I didn't think having a simple conversation would be this hard!)
Mapplouge, I think?
Mapplouge? The heck is that? Some weird combination of Marouge and Appleton?
Wait a sec. Are you just makin' stuff up 'cause you don't know much about makeup, Haruka-chan?
You're a pop idol, aren't you? I figured you'd know this kinda stuff!
I'm sorry, I really don't know all that much about it...
(That didn't go very well... I never thought having a simple conversation would be this hard.)
I use Appleton.
Oh, really? That's the same as me!
Yeah, cool, huh?
(I had to lie, but no harm in a little white lie, right?)
Oh, but Marouge is good, too! You should definitely give it a try sometime, okay?
Sure, sounds great. I'll put Marouge on my list.
You don't even have to, though. Appleton's the best. Ya can't go changing it, 'cause we're Appleton Girls!
(I think that went well. Maybe we can be friends after all!)
So anyway, Haruka-chan, I know you're busy, but what about school? Are ya planning on going to college or anything?
Hmm. I don't know. I haven't really thought about it. There's just so much to do with work.
Oh. So you might not have to deal with entrance exams or any of that?
Uh, no, maybe not...
Must be nice. Wait, though, if you're not gonna take entrance exams, what's the point of goin' to school at all?
Geez, Hiromi, that was kinda mean, you know? I mean, it's not like Haruka-chan doesn't wanna go to school or anything, right?
Right! I like going to school!
Well, okay, but I'm still kinda confused. Why do ya even bother with school, Haruka-chan?
I think high school is a place where I can study and learn about things. It lets me learn about people, too.
Oh, I getcha. I bet you wish you could come to school more often then, huh?
See, I told ya. It's not like Haruka-chan doesn't wanna come to school. Right, Haruka-chan?
Yeah. I wish I could spend time with people my own age, whether it's in class or just hanging out during lunch. That way, I could get away from the work side of the world.
Oh, yeah. I bet in the idol world, everyone your age is competing for sales and attention. Can't really make friends with them, then, huh?
And you could really relax with some people outside of the business at school.
I guess. To be honest, I really don't know...
Oh. Really?
We shouldn'ta asked that, huh?
No, no, it's okay.
Um, Haruka-chan, please don't quit school, okay?
Oh, sheesh, Hiromi! You coulda been a bit more thoughtful. Sorry 'bout that, Haruka-chan.
It's just that I haven't made many friends yet at school.
Really? We can be your friends, if ya like?
It'd be so cool to be friends with a celebrity! I can totally brag about it.
Ooh, yeah, Haruka-chan, can I tell my friends about ya? And how we're friends?
Uh, well, sure. Of course.
(They just want to know me as a celebrity. I wonder if I can ever be just a regular friend...)
It must be so cool to be a pop star, Haruka-chan. You get to meet all sorts of celebrities all the time, don'tcha?
Yeah, Haruka-chan, didn't I see ya on TV together with Nonomiya-kun the other night?
No way, really? I'm a huge fan of his! Did ya get to talk with him, Haruka-chan? What was he like?
(Nonomiya-kun? I don't remember him.)
No. I didn't talk to him at all. I don't really have any friends in the celebrity world...
Sure, maybe not yet. But if you play your cards right, maybe you could even date Nonomiya-kun someday!
Don't like guy celebrities hit ya up for your number or email?
Is it true your manager won't let you date anyone? Doesn't that suck?
No, there's nothing like that...
So you've got a boyfriend, then?
No, I don't.
Why not? It's no fun not havin' a guy around. Why don't ya find yourself a boyfriend?
Well, because, uh, romance isn't really a priority for me right now. It's not all that important, anyway.
Huh? Is that some kinda dig at us?
We got boyfriends. Ya got somethin' against us thinkin' romance is important?
That isn't what I meant!
Well, then, what didja mean?
Gee, Haruka-chan, you're not as nice as how ya present yourself on TV.
(Oh, no... This is really not the way to make friends, is it?)
Right now, I want to concentrate on my career. I don't have time to get a boyfriend.
I guess so. You're still tryin' to make it. Can't afford a scandal now, huh?
And when you're a star, they put ya on a diet so ya can't eat what ya want, right?
Yeah? When ya put it that way, maybe this bein' a star thing ain't all that fun.
Oh, no, work is fun. It does feel great when you have all those people cheering you on.
Oh, but your fans. Aren't they mostly like, creepy otaku guys?
That doesn't really bother me...
That's enough, Madoka! I'm your fan, Haruka-chan. You're gonna keep at it, right?
Oh, uh, yeah! Thanks.
I just think I'm a little young for a serious boyfriend.
That ain't true. Why, Madoka here had a guy back in middle school!
Hey! Don't go spillin' my whole story like that!
Wait, wait, so ya mean ya haven't had your first kiss yet?
Huh? Uh, er, um...
Whoa! Not yet!? No way, no way, no way!
No friggin' way! You're kiddin', right?
(Ugh... I want to go home!)
(What should I order?)
Thank you kindly.
Let me show you to your table. If you'll please follow me.
Welcome! What can I get you?
Oh, I'd like a <Color:8>Sotenbori Set<Color:Default>!
(Honoka-chan wants to eat a <Color:8>Sotenbori Set<Color:Default>.)
This looks delish!
Did you see the guy outside tryin' to hit on girls?
Oh, was there a guy? I didn't even notice.
Yeah, he's been there since before I got to work today. He's been hittin' on girls all day.
Guess he isn't having much luck. I don't know how a guy can keep that up for so long.
Do you ever do that sorta thing, Akiyama-san?
I don't. Not under most circumstances, anyway.
For real? Ya don't think you'd be able to get a ton of girls, Akiyama-san?
It's not about whether I could or not. I prefer to treat meeting people more seriously.
Hmm. Okay, what if some cute girl were to try and pick you up?
I'd be okay with that. I could never say no to a pretty lady.
Whaaat? But you were just sayin' ya take meetin' people more seriously than that!
It's not like that. It's a pretty rare thing for a girl to be the one to make a move like that. I wouldn't want to waste such a unique chance.
Even if she wasn't your type?
It's not like we're going to start dating on the spot, but there's nothing wrong with having a coffee date or something.
So what you're sayin' is that ya've got no standards if some random girl asks ya out. Ain't you quite the flirt?
That's harsh.
No way would I go for that. Going on a date with a girl who picks up guys like that is sure to end in disaster.
For serious? Why's that?
Well, if they're hitting on you in the middle of the street, they're only judging you by your looks.
It seems obvious that there's a high likelihood of our personalities or interests not matching, and a quick breakup will be inevitable.
Yeah, I guess that's true. For me, if a guy said he didn't like stand-up comedy, then it's game over, no matter how good he looks.
See? That's why I prefer to take my time to get to know the other person first.
Aha! You're not as much of a playboy as ya look, Akiyama-san! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Uh, thanks.
Depends on the situation.
What kinda situation?
Well, let's say if the girl's my type. If she isn't, I wouldn't go on a date with her.
So if she's yer type it's okay?
Yeah. If she struck me as sketchy, then I'd obviously keep my distance.
What do ya mean by sketchy?
Well, you've heard of badger games, right? When a good-looking lady tricks some dumb schmuck in order to blackmail him?
Pretty women usually can't keep guys away from them, so when they approach a man it's kind of suspicious. I know I'd be on my guard then.
Ooh, you're so calculating, Akiyama-san! I would never have thought of that. I'd just blindly follow the guy if he's my type.
Then you should be more careful from now on.
Thanks for treatin' me!
Here is your check.
Let me show you to your table.
Uncle Kaz, I'd really like some <Color:8>Garlic Chicken<Color:Default>.
(Haruka wants some <Color:8>Garlic Chicken<Color:Default>...)
But I wanted some <Color:8>Garlic Chicken<Color:Default>...
This looks really tasty! Thanks, Uncle Kaz!
Thanks for treating me!
That was delicious!
I hope that was to your liking. Please come again.
Sorry. I have some urgent business to take care of.
(What do I want to eat?)
(What should I get?)
(What do I wanna eat?)
(Okay, what do I want to get?)
(Hmm. I wonder what's good?)
Sorry. I have some urgent business I need to take care of.
Your performance was a bit off, Uncle Kaz.
Thanks for cheering me on, Uncle Kaz! I was really able to sing well!
That was a lot of fun, Uncle Kaz! Call me again soon!
Sure, I'll do that.
Well ain't you good at this, Akiyama-san? I'm kinda surprised!
That wasn't all that impressive, ya know.
I gotta get back to Tokyo now. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Today was lots of fun, Haruka. Will you give me a call again sometime?
Sure! I'd love for us to sing together again!
Uncle Kaz, see if you can help me get <Color:8>at least 900 points on "Because I Have You"<Color:Default>!
